# Additions to Esther Chapter 6 (Addition F) — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalent)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Codex Vaticanus, Additions to Esther F | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-DC/ADE_006_page_001.jpg

---

*[Addition F: Mordecai interprets his dream and the book closes with its colophon.]*

**1** Then Mordecai said: "All this has come from God.

**2** For I remember the dream I had about these matters, and not a single thing in it has gone unfulfilled.

**3** The small spring that became a river, with light and sun and abundant water — that is Esther, whom the king married and made queen.

**4** And the two dragons — that is Haman and myself.

**5** And the nations are those who gathered to destroy the name of the Jews.

**6** And my nation — that is Israel, those who cried out to God and were saved. For the Lord saved his people; the Lord rescued us from all these evils; and God worked great signs and wonders, the like of which have never occurred among the nations.

**7** For this reason he prepared two lots: one for the people of God, and one for all the nations.

**8** And these two lots came at the appointed time, on the day of judgment, before God and before all the nations.

**9** And God remembered his people and vindicated his inheritance.

**10** Therefore they shall observe these days in the month of Adar, on the fourteenth and fifteenth of that month, with assembly and joy and gladness before God, throughout all generations, forever among his people Israel."

**11** [Colophon:] In the fourth year of the reign of Ptolemy and Cleopatra, Dositheus — who identified himself as a priest and a Levite — and his son Ptolemy brought this letter of Purim, which they said had been translated by Lysimachus son of Ptolemy, one of the residents of Jerusalem.
